fees.note: From the park's own camping page (read 2026-10-14): $40 a night for a back-in site and $45 for a pull-through, $240 a week and $600 a month. fees.note: From the park's own camping page (read 2026-10-14): $27 a night for an electric site and $17 without electric, $22 and $12 from October 15 to May 1. A reservation adds $7.50 in person or by phone and $10.00 online, and paying by card 3%. Camping fees do not include the vehicle admission sticker every vehicle needs: $7 a day, $16 a weekend, $19 a holiday weekend or $26 a year. A site takes up to 6 guests, plus $2 per extra guest. CampLife took no date read, October 2026 to June 2027; online booking for 2027 opens February 1.
